# Hash-pinned dependency set for the Codecov CLI, used by .github/workflows/codecov.yml.
#
# A bare `pip3 install codecov-cli` resolves fresh from PyPI on every run, so the
# uploader that reports our coverage numbers was itself unpinned. Installed with
# `--require-hashes`, pip refuses anything whose artifact does not match a hash below.
# This is what Scorecard's PinnedDependenciesID asks for on pip commands.
#
# Regenerate with:
#   echo 'codecov-cli' | uv pip compile - --generate-hashes --universal \
#     --python-version 3.12 -o .github/requirements/codecov-cli.txt
